scientific_target: Construct one admissible mediator law giving both a static force kernel and a quantum coherence kernel; identify cross-domain predictions and unsupplied premises
premises: Canonical independent real Klein-Gordon fields with inverse lengths mu>=0 in Minkowski vacuum
One normalized positive mass measure nu(dmu)=ell^s mu^(s-1) exp(-ell mu) dmu/Gamma(s), s>0, ell>0
The same scalar combination couples linearly to all declared matter operators with a fixed coupling-basis vector
A massless metric response is a separately supplied common geometric sector, not derived from the scalar fields

Two-position coherence benchmark: equal scalar charges, fixed separation d, Gaussian spatial source amplitude exp(-a^2 k^2/2), a>0, common top-hat duration T; external preparation and recombination supplied
No environmental occupations or classical stochastic force are added to the specified vacuum

parameters.matter_couplings: fixed vector; universal subfamily distinguished from composition-sensitive alternatives
parameters.a_d_T: apparatus inputs, not inferred from force data

calibration_inputs: None for mathematical construction. Any later Cassini/MICROSCOPE/clock calibration will be a separately frozen version of the observation map.
tests: Direct spectral quadrature against the closed static potential and force
Low-frequency local and spatial-difference noise exponents and leading constants from direct phase-space integration
Coherent-state overlap against oscillator evolution, independently implemented
Finite time decoherence against an analytic all-T positive-measure bound
Massless and zero-separation limits, finite-size source and switching dependence
observation_boundary: The fixed two-position hold is not the full LUMI Talbot-Lau trajectory. A molecular mass scale illustration is not a fit or experimental visibility prediction. Proper detector/trajectory maps are required for comparison.
novelty_boundary: Generalized free fields, Yukawa exchange, influence functionals and vacuum fluctuation-dissipation are standard controls. The research target is their explicit shared-parameter observation map and discriminator, not priority for those identities.
standing: Conditional candidate mechanism; no adopted premise, audit verdict or TOE completion
